stories.title: Renner, da dupla com Rick, pede orações e que ‘mantenham a fé’ durante as buscas pelo helicóptero

en.title: Renner, from the duo with Rick, asks for prayers and to 'maintain faith' during helicopter search
en.summary: Renner, Rick's musical partner, has requested prayers and encouragement during the ongoing search for the helicopter.

stories.title: Assembleia Geral da ONU começa hoje em NY em meio a grave crise; Lula é o 1º líder a discursar

en.title: UN General Assembly begins today in NY amid serious crisis; Lula is 1st leader to speak
en.summary: The UN's 81st General Assembly opened in New York amid an existential crisis, with Brazilian President Lula delivering the first speech, followed by Trump, as the organization faces budget cuts and criticism.

en.title: Macron says he had 'very constructive' meeting with Trump on Ukraine and Red Sea
en.summary: French President Macron described his meeting with Trump as constructive, discussing matters related to Ukraine and the Red Sea region.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja quem são os candidatos a governador, senador, deputado federal e estadual no Amapá

en.title: 2026 Elections: see who are the candidates for governor, senator, federal and state deputy in Amapá
en.summary: Voters in Amapá will go to the polls on October 4, 2026 to elect a governor, two senators, eight federal deputies, and 24 state deputies. The election is part of general elections that will define the state's representatives for the next four years.

stories.title: Mãe diz que jovem encontrada morta em condomínio reclamava do comportamento do namorado: 'Era muito ciumento'

en.title: Mother says young woman found dead in condominium complained about boyfriend's behavior: 'He was very jealous'
en.summary: The mother of a 22-year-old law student found dead outside a condominium in Fortaleza reported that her daughter had complained about her boyfriend's jealous behavior and constant surveillance. Police in Ceará are searching for the boyfriend.

en.summary: The United Nations is selecting a new leader during a period of declining institutional credibility and erosion of multilateral cooperation.

en.title: Ballon d'Or 2026 becomes 'unknown'; see who are the candidates
en.summary: The 2026 Ballon d'Or award remains uncertain regarding its eventual winner. Several candidates are in contention for the prestigious football honor.

stories.title: FAB e bombeiros buscam helicóptero com cantor Rick, desaparecido em SC

en.title: Brazilian Air Force and firefighters search for helicopter with singer Rick, missing in SC
en.summary: The Brazilian Air Force and Santa Catarina firefighters are searching for helicopter PP-MGR that disappeared on Monday afternoon near São Joaquim. The aircraft departed from Porto Belo and was carrying singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner, along with entrepreneur Bruno Avelar.

stories.title: Bets, juros e dívidas devem levar brasileiro a buscar mais descontos na Black Friday

en.title: Bets, interest rates and debts should lead Brazilians to seek more discounts in Black Friday
en.summary: Brazilian consumers facing high interest rates, significant household debt, and spending on sports betting are expected to prioritize discounts during the 2026 Black Friday sales.

stories.title: Bom relacionamento com o chefe é o fator mais valorizado no emprego, diz pesquisa

en.title: Good relationship with boss is the most valued factor in employment, research says
en.summary: A study by Cornerstone Career Services in partnership with Insper, based on interviews with 880 professionals, found that having a good relationship with superiors is one of the most valued attributes across all generations in the job market.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: Saiba a função dos cargos em disputa

en.title: 2026 Elections: Learn the function of positions up for dispute
en.summary: Brazil will hold elections in October 2026 for president, governors, senators, and federal and state deputies, with approximately 158 million eligible voters. The first round will occur on October 4, with voting proceeding in a specified order across different positions.

stories.title: Bolsas asiáticas fecham em alta com impulso de Wall Street

en.title: Asian stock markets close higher with boost from Wall Street
en.summary: Most Asian stock markets closed higher on Tuesday, with positive market sentiment following a rally on Wall Street the previous day.

stories.title: Godard proibido, prisão de Shakespeare, despreparo intelectual: livro relembra absurdos da censura no Brasil

en.title: Godard banned, Shakespeare imprisoned, intellectual unpreparedness: book recalls absurdities of censorship in Brazil
en.summary: A book documents instances of censorship in Brazil, including prohibitions of filmmakers like Godard and restrictions on Shakespeare, illustrating the intellectual inadequacy of such measures.
